name: Mori Aoba
source:
A girl who lives in the room next to Maito. She calls him "Onii-chan" and is faintly in love with him. She is a reserved and shy person. She is poor at schoolwork and exercise, but she handles housework flawlessly.

[Based on [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=600425]Getchu[/url]]
